create_faiss_indexer: create an Indexer with a flat inner product index for a given vector size
create_pq_indexer: create an Indexer using Product Quantization with subquantizers and bit width for compressed indexing
index_embeddings: index a batch of document embeddings with their corresponding database IDs into the FAISS index
search_knn_vectors: search the FAISS index with query vectors to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor document IDs and scores
serialize_index: serialize the FAISS index and its ID mapping metadata to disk for later reuse
